sections.heading: HTI At A Glance
sections.body: HTI is a hospitality and corporate training institute with 24 years of experience partnering with leading hotels, restaurants, airlines, healthcare brands, and corporates across India and internationally. The institute specializes in guest experience training, leadership development, and service excellence programs that transform frontline teams into customer-focused professionals. What do a luxury resort in the Maldives, a buzzing restaurant in Dubai, a five-star hotel in India, a hospital ward, a bank branch, and an airport lounge all have in common? At some point over the last 24 years, HTI has probably been there — quietly working behind the scenes, helping shape the way service is delivered. Not with noise. Not with slogans. But with people, purpose and practice.
sections.tip_text: Customers appreciate systems and professionalism, but they remember and return for experiences.

sections.heading: A Journey Across Worlds
sections.body: From training resort personnel to convert small moments into memories, to training a pre-opening restaurant team on how to turn standard service into an engaging story… To cabin crew learning the art of image projection and management. Or a mix of young managers and veterans learning the science of leadership. Or a young supervisor building public speaking skills, and confidence in the training room. Different worlds. Same intention. To make service feel human.
sections.tip_text: From India to the Maldives, UAE and Saudi Arabia — HTI has shaped service culture across the globe for over two decades.

sections.heading: Hotels, Resorts & Hospitality
sections.body: Hilton, Taj Mahal Hotel, Sahara Star, Ginger Hotels, Spark by Hilton. Singinawa Jungle Lodge, Pugdundee Safaris, Aahana Resort, Club Mahindra. Atmosphere Kanifushi and OBLU Resort in the Maldives. From global luxury brands to intimate wildlife stays — HTI has helped shape service culture across every format of hospitality.
sections.tip_text: Every hotel has a brand promise. HTI helps the front-of-house team live it — every shift, every guest, every day.

sections.heading: Restaurants & F&B Brands
sections.body: Speciality Restaurants (Mainland China, Sigree, Asia Kitchen, Hoppipola); The Yellow Chilli; Azure Hospitality (Mamagoto, Sly Granny, Foxtrot, Dhaba); Aditya Birla New Age Hospitality (Hakkasan, Yauatcha, Cin Cin, Nara Thai, Ode, Flint, Warsa). Grub Shack, India Club, Stadium Bar Grill Sheesha, Dubai. Almunajem Foods Company in Saudi Arabia.
sections.tip_text: From casual dining to fine dining — HTI training programs turn standard service into memorable guest experiences.

sections.heading: Corporate, Healthcare & Aviation
sections.body: BPCL, HPCL, State Bank of India, Tata Motors, Pidilite, Manipal Hospitals, Karkinos Healthcare, Zomato, Birla Opus, Zodiac Shirts. Oberoi Airport Services, Indian Airlines, Air India, Air India Express. Great service is not exclusive to hospitality — HTI brings the same discipline to every sector.
sections.tip_text: From banks to hospitals to airports — service excellence is a universal language and HTI speaks it across industries.

sections.heading: Education & Institutions
sections.body: MET, Kohinoor Management School, Apeejay Institute of Hospitality, Hiranandani Foundation School, Pillai Institute of Management Studies, Anjuman Islam Institute of Hospitality Management, Kotak Education Foundation. HTI has shaped the next generation of hospitality professionals at some of India's most respected institutions.
sections.tip_text: The future of hospitality starts in the classroom. HTI ensures students graduate with skills that make an immediate impact.

sections.heading: What We Have Learnt Along The Way
sections.body: It is never the logo that defines the experience. It is the Front Of House staff who choose patience over procedure. The restaurant team that celebrates a guest smile like a shared achievement. The cabin crew who turn routine service into something personal. The young leader who walks in unsure — and walks out changed. These are not training outcomes. These are human moments. And they are the only ones that last. Wherever people believe service matters, HTI shows up. To shape it. To refine it. To remind teams that great service is never accidental.
